title: Constant PV LMR discount
hypothesis: Removing aspiration-window delta dependence from LMR and using a constant PV-node reduction discount can reduce search-effort feedback from aspiration failures while preserving the existing sparse NNUE evaluation path.
feature: Search-only LMR change derived from Stockfish PR #7148: remove rootDelta/delta coupling, apply a constant -512 reduction adjustment at PV nodes, and retune the reduction offset from 982 to 948.
promotion_rule: Only promote to a larger Fishtest-style SPRT if the small paired screen is not clearly negative; do not merge from the screen alone.
notes: FAYE-0001 Complexity-LMR was rejected after post-SPSA validation. FAYE-0002 intentionally changes a separate search mechanism and does not add or duplicate NNUE relational features.
